scope: New Android-only controlled static bevel-bandwidth comparison, separate from the older native-reference evidence atlas. Not iOS optical or motion parity.

public_subset: Four composed comparison PNGs, one 16-scene compact summary and the controlled capture report. Original 32 full PNGs remain in the capture archive; their hashes are preserved inside capture-result.json.
